what: Per-event CPU of the hot path on the golden payments set (contracts/testdata/golden/payments), single thread, in-process store and model. Before Part S (generic bindings); compare after each S phase on the same host.
host: 4 vCPU / 15 GB, compose stack up and idle

notes: Flink parses the protobuf once in the deserializer, again in each of the 7 keyed stages and again in scoring: ~8 x parse_us per event.
filter_mask_us is the 8 CEL filters evaluated once per event at the source.
Flink: one protobuf parse + one row decode (row_decode_us) per event instead of 8 parses; the keyed stages aggregate on the decoded row (agg_*_us now measured on rows).
Envelope carries the EventRow (keys, slots); in features mode it drops the raw event bytes (no stage reads them).
